title: Rooftop Views | 12 Beds | Near Broadway!
description:
Experience Nashville in comfort with this spacious home featuring 12 beds, a rooftop retreat, fully stocked kitchen, and open design ideal for groups and even enough space to bring your dog along. Enjoy the convenience of a 2-car garage and plenty of room to relax before exploring downtown, just minutes away. Whether gathering with friends or unwinding after a night out, this home offers the perfect mix of style, space, and location for your stay.

The space
Modern Luxury ★ Sleeps 16 ★ Massive Rooftop Deck

Welcome to your classic Nashville escape! This spacious home features high-end designer finishes throughout — from hardwood floors and granite countertops to stainless steel appliances and custom lighting.

✔️ Sleeps up to 16 comfortably
• 4 Bedrooms: 1 King, 5 Queen,and  6 Single beds
✔️ Fully stocked modern kitchen – gas range, stainless steel appliances, and everything you need to cook and entertain
✔️ 2 Car Garage for safe and secure parking that's always available
✔️ Rooftop terrace – perfect for sunset views and gathering
✔️ Smart TVs – stream your favorite shows in multiple rooms
✔️ Nashville Guitar mural, picture perfect moment

FLOOR PLAN:
1st Floor- 6 twin beds and a full bathroom
2nd Floor- kitchen, living room, 2 queen beds, and a full bathroom
3rd Floor- Primary bedroom with king bed and full bath, additional room with 3 queen beds and a full bath
4th Floor- Rooftop

This home is 4 stories as noted. Stairs will need to be climbed throughout stay.

All of this makes for a perfect home base for families, groups, or corporate stays.

Prime Location ★ Easy Access to Music City Hotspots

You’re just minutes from Nashville’s best attractions, restaurants, and nightlife. Uber or Lyft puts everything within easy reach:

2–4 Minutes:
• The Parthenon & Centennial Park
• Climb Nashville
• Dozens of great restaurants, bars & breweries

5–8 Minutes:
• Broadway & Honky Tonk Central
• The Gulch
• Nissan Stadium (Titans games – join our tailgate!)
• Bridgestone Arena (Predators hockey, concerts)
• Top Golf
• First Tennessee Park (Nashville Sounds)
• Ascend Amphitheater
• Ryman Auditorium

10–15 Minutes:
• Nashville International Airport (BNA)
• Gaylord Opryland Resort & The Grand Ole Opry

You can even walk to Pastaria, Avo, Sump Coffee, Sandbar and the Nashville Brewing Company – all under 10 minutes on foot!

Come enjoy the perfect mix of location, comfort, and fun — your unforgettable Nashville stay starts here.

Guest access
You'll receive a personalized access code before check-in for smooth, keyless entry. During your stay, you’ll have full access to the entire home — all living spaces, bedrooms, the rooftop terrace, and the game room are yours to enjoy. Access will end promptly at check-out time.

Other things to note
CHECK-IN: 4PM & CHECK-OUT 10AM:
We may be able to provide an early check-in or a late check-out for an additional fee only if our schedule allows and hosts pre-approve in advance. The early check-in or late check-out additional accommodations start at $200. We can not accept any requests made within 3 days of your trip or during your stay because our cleaners are scheduled in advance and their schedules can not be changed last minute. Please pre-arrange in advance. 

NO LOCALS:
We do not rent to locals who live Nashville or who live within 60 miles. Please do not book our home if you are local or plan to have locals visiting. We reserve the right to cancel any reservation without refund of any local who books our home. Thank you! 

GUESTS WILL NEED TO USE STAIRS:
This 3-story home has many stairs. Guests will need to use stairs during their stay. We are happy to host children, but it's important to note that our home is not childproofed and has many stairs. Please supervise children at all times.

SECURITY:
There are multiple cameras located on the outside of the home. There are 3 cameras by the front door, one camera near the garage, and one rooftop camera. All of these record both sound and audio. There are absolutely no cameras inside the home. These are there for your safety and protection.

DOGS:
We happily welcome 1-2 well-behaved, house-trained adult dogs to stay in our home. We ask that all dogs be crated when left alone in our home, so please bring a crate with you. To ensure a smooth process, all dogs must be discussed and pre-approved by host within 24 hours of booking. Please be sure to add them to your reservation. $100 flat pet fee applies for up to two dogs. We regret to inform you that dogs under 1 year old, cats, or other animals are not allowed. Be please respectful and clean up after your dog(s) in our yard to avoid a fine. Any damage from pet will guests responsibility as an inspection will occur at check-out.

A lot of time, care, and money has been put into this home that we LOVE. We only want to have the best guests who will respect our property and neighbors. If you've made it this far on the listing and have questions, please send us an inquiry!
